prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you need a residential or commercial tester/repairer, and what zip code or street in Liberty (MO) is the job at? With that I can try to give specific local companies. 

If you want to start now, here are the fastest ways to find qualified backflow testing and repair near Liberty, MO plus what to check for:

How to find testers
- Contact the City of Liberty Utilities / Public Works — they often keep a list of approved/certified backflow testers for customers.
- Search “backflow testing Liberty MO” or use business sites (Google Maps, Yelp, Angi, HomeAdvisor) and filter for plumbers/irrigation companies that list “backflow testing” or “backflow prevention.”
- Check the American Backflow Prevention Association (ABPA) or your state/county cross-connection control program for lists of certified testers.

What to verify before hiring
- Certified tester: ask for the tester’s backflow tester certification and any Missouri/local registration required.
- License & insurance: plumber/contractor’s license and general liability insurance.
- Written test report: you should receive a stamped/written test report suitable for submitting to the city.
- Experience with your device type (reduced pressure, double check, etc.) and whether they handle repairs and parts replacement.
- Ask if they will file the test results with the city or if you need to submit them.

Typical costs (ballpark)
- Annual test-only: roughly $75–$200 depending on device and region.
- Repairs/replacement: varies widely by part and device; get a written estimate before work.

If you want, give me the exact address or zip code (or say “residential vs commercial”), and I’ll list a few specific local companies you can call.
